races.paceDynamic: Westgate Warrior will take them along as the sole confirmed leader in a field where 7 runners want prominent positions within the first two furlongs. The massive congestion behind the leader will create significant traffic problems turning into the straight, with Papa Don't Preach, Herakles, Street Life, Irish Dancer, Basholo, Jeany May and Colors Of Freedom all fighting for the same tactical position. This sets up perfectly for the hold-up horses Woodhay Whisper, Popular Dream, South Shore and Ancient State to find cleaner passages late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Westgate Warrior Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Westgate Warrior gets uncontested fractions and the prominent pack gets tangled.
scenarios.body: The leader builds enough cushion while the pack behind scrambles for position through congested early stages. Westgate Warrior holds on with one of the hold-up horses picking up the pieces.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners create a wall effect and the pace collapses turning in.
scenarios.body: The seven prominent runners box each other in while Westgate Warrior dies in front from lack of pressure. Ancient State or Woodhay Whisper find the cleanest route to sweep past the stalled leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Breaks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent pack (Irish Dancer/Basholo) gets first run and clear sailing.
scenarios.body: Irish Dancer or Basholo manage to secure an ideal position just behind Westgate Warrior without getting trapped. They get first run at the leader while the others are still fighting for racing room.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Westgate Warrior goes too slow and everyone converges in a bunch finish.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the entire field to arrive together turning for home. It becomes a pure speed battle over the final furlong with any horse capable of winning.

watchPoints.text: Watch for Westgate Warrior getting too easy a lead as the prominent pack sorts itself out behind.
Irish Dancer and Basholo need to show early speed to avoid being trapped behind the wall of prominent runners.
Ancient State and Woodhay Whisper must find clear runs from the back as traffic will be severe turning in.
Colors Of Freedom could be overlooked value if the pace collapses and it becomes a sprint finish.
Papa Don't Preach's ability to secure position early will determine if he can use his consistent form.

scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Favors Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent group maintains a strong gallop and the pace doesn't collapse
scenarios.body: The front-runners stretch the field and the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground in the closing stages. Bad Habits and Amelia's Joy benefit from their forward positions and proven course form.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sprint Finish Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes modest and the field compresses into the final furlong
scenarios.body: A wall of hold-up horses emerges from the pack with Gladiadora, Court Of Session, and Call Glory all swooping late. The winner comes from those who get the clearest run and strongest finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Rusheen Boy Wire Job
scenarios.trigger: If Rusheen Boy gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The pace-setter builds an unassailable advantage while the field is still organizing behind him. Despite his hold-up rivals closing late, Rusheen Boy's head start proves decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a pure sprint from the 2f pole
scenarios.body: Create or Siviez finds the gaps that elude the fancied hold-up horses in a blanket finish. The winner emerges from traffic at long odds while favorites are caught flat-footed.

races.paceDynamic: Tamashal, Delinquent, and Watchdog will force a strong gallop from the gates, creating genuine pace pressure in this 9-runner handicap. Four horses (Dagger Strike, Kanishka, Mayaada, The Resdev Scholar) all want prominent positions behind the leaders, creating inevitable traffic congestion entering the final 3f. The strong pace will favor the hold-up horses Illy's Roo and Acclaimed Freedom if they can secure clean runs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If all three leaders (Tamashal, Delinquent, Watchdog) engage early and maintain strong gallop throughout.
scenarios.body: The relentless pace stretches the field and exhausts the prominent pack. Hold-up horses with clean runs capitalize in the final furlong as leaders falter.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Slowdown
scenarios.trigger: If Tamashal and Delinquent settle more conservatively, leaving only Watchdog to force the pace.
scenarios.body: The reduced early pace allows prominent runners to travel comfortably and unleash finishing kicks. Higher-rated horses assert class advantage in sprint finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the four prominent runners bunch together behind leaders, creating interference 2-3f out.
scenarios.body: Clean passage becomes crucial as several chances are compromised by congestion. Leaders benefit from clear runs while hold-up horses struggle for racing room.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Perfect Storm
scenarios.trigger: If early leader drops out quickly, creating gaps for prominent runners to exploit.
scenarios.body: The pace collapses allowing mid-division horses to position perfectly for sustained drives. Form horses with tactical speed dominate the finish.

races.paceDynamic: Lady Kameko is the sole confirmed front runner and should get an uncontested lead in this field of predominantly hold-up horses. This creates a tactical race where positioning and late acceleration will be crucial rather than sustained speed.

scenarios.label: C

scenarios.trigger: If the field bunches up and several hold-up horses get blocked

scenarios.label: D

scenarios.body: The extended trip and sustained pressure from the leader creates an attritional contest favoring proven stayers. Moon Over The Sea's stamina and Shabu Shabu's distance form come to the fore in a grinding finish.
